title: Audit paid-query composition at the actual QQ16 bridge
body:
The actual ordinary bridge after F0/B1 needs current Y, which the earlier 96-output F17 projection does not supply alone. This package adds eight paid current-query outputs and constructs a complete local consumer of the resulting 104-field boundary. Exact routed algebra proves the bridge update for arbitrary arrays, including all owned dirt and endpoint frames.

The literal serial composition costs **208 H1 children, 416 native wrappers, 400 cover maps and 15,040 scalar primitive allowance**, with 120 exclusive full-cover workspace fields and eight owner-private fields, all returned zero/identity. Exact fusion cancels the added query subtraction/reconstruction and leaves the existing 96 source bridge ADDs. Thus this repair closes the information gap but removes no additional source work for this bridge-only endpoint. Under the same conditional common-label native entry boundary, direct subtraction costs 768 scalar allowance; preserving and clearing the same 120 allocated dirty fields costs 1,008 and is checked against every final serial value/frame.

This is a scoped local construction and stop result. The original hosted template uses gauge44; actual QQ16 placement, inter-pair alignment, movement, storage, rounded precision, coverage and recursive supplier admission remain open. It is not a global cost rejection, a universal bridge lower bound, or an eight-new-family lower bound. The next viable step is a changed producer that deletes named source work, or an actual independent continuation that shares the h/query computation. No centre-retirement saving is counted again.

Validation: normal and optimized read-only replay; 106,496 exact signed native basis columns; four semantic word mutants plus wrong inverse-kernel translation; seven boundary tests including Git-free read-only export and source/word/typed-receipt corruption; registered package replay and baseline binding check all passed.
